provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

systematic_backtest_license.evidence: Series-level source and copyright restrictions require a selected-series review.

local_cache_permitted.evidence: Local retention rights depend on each underlying series source and have not been reviewed.

revision_retention.evidence: The API exposes vintage dates and real-time periods.

stable_instrument_identifier.evidence: Macro observations are keyed by stable FRED series IDs.

timezone_defined.evidence: Release-time timezone and intraday availability policy has not been specified per release.

source_timestamp_semantics.evidence: FRED documents real-time periods and ALFRED vintages.

vintage_observations.evidence: ALFRED supports historical vintages rather than only today's revised history.

release_timestamp_or_conservative_lag.evidence: Many series expose dates rather than a safely tradable intraday timestamp; a conservative lag policy is not yet registered.

revision_dates.evidence: series/vintagedates returns dates when values were revised or newly released.

series_metadata_history.evidence: Historical metadata definition and seasonal-adjustment changes are not yet retained.

notes: FRED latest values must never substitute for ALFRED vintages in a historical decision.
